name: Greedy Meshing with Unity MeshData API
definition: A method to generate optimized voxel meshes using greedy mesher algorithms, executed in parallel via Unity Jobs, and written directly to GPU buffers using the MeshData API to avoid CPU-GPU synchronization overhead.
summary: Greedy Meshing with Unity MeshData API generates optimized voxel meshes in parallel via Unity Jobs, writing directly to GPU buffers to avoid CPU-GPU synchronization overhead and garbage collection spikes.
